minimum_protocol.gpu_plan: co-locate native and frozen R on one idle physical4/5/6; keep two cards globally idle; split across two cards only if that idle-card floor still holds
minimum_protocol.stop: abort only own episode on physical safety or malformed reset; no retry/tuning/new fitting
minimum_protocol.reference: uninterrupted source-PD witness per cell; endpoint + elapsed1s +8 observed future; declare final-PD hold; never splice or use live future
minimum_protocol.paired_initial: all three arms share and compare visible+hidden native reset state; source trajectories differ by cell
minimum_protocol.no_tau_fallback: same frozen executor zero-tau/valid=false; report actual mask each control
minimum_protocol.task_inputs: same declared narrow lift5cm/force/coupled/unsupported elapsed1s task in every arm; full original RELEASE scored separately, never substitute
metrics: first loss vs actual valid tau
frozen action RMSE on fixed reference states
minimum_protocol.decision_rule: If any source-positive shifted/distinct cell loses baseline success after calibration, flag observed regression; paired hold decrease >=0.2s is a warning. All source-negative cells are inconclusive. A pass is only a small-screen pass, not a population non-inferiority claim.
minimum_protocol.expansion: two repeats of the failing cell only if a regression changes the next decision; no training; do not reuse for checkpoint selection

limitations: Nominal single-row forwards are compatibility checks, not transfer RMSE or physical performance.
Prefer same-object DEV; if unavailable use lexically first bounded different-object DEV and record the object/trajectory confound. Broader evaluation remains future evidence.
Historical source-PD original81 channel remains the fit target; extended reference is not silently treated as old calibration supervision.
